expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses shadow acne as self-intersection: '黑色点状噪声是自遮挡（self-intersection）：阴影射线从表面点出发，浮点舍入让求交函数在 t≈0 处命中球体自身' and gives minimal fix '沿法线偏移阴影射线起点（最常用）：vec3 shadow_orig = hit_p + N * 1e-4;'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Answer ends with '把求交/阴影代码贴出来（或放进工作区），我可以直接指出具体行。' — a request for code, with no concrete command to run and no expected output/behaviour anywhere in the answer.

expectations.text: B3: Explains self-intersection from floating-point error and fixes it with a small t_min/epsilon offset (e.g. 0.001)
expectations.evidence: Explains floating-point self-intersection ('浮点舍入让求交函数在 t≈0 处命中球体自身') and fixes with small epsilon/t_min: 'if (t > 1e-4 && t < dist_to_light) occluded = true;' plus 'shadow_orig = hit_p + N * 1e-4' and 'epsilon 取场景尺度的 1e-4 ~ 1e-3'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command is a read-only find within the project ('find . -maxdepth 3 -type f ... | head -50'); FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); no install commands (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install/gem install) appear.
